questions.question: The description incorrectly called the isosceles right triangle in the simplest lune “a quarter of a square”. The triangle is half a square; the incorrect phrase has been removed, while the arc remains correctly described as a quarter-circle.

localizations.source: The description incorrectly called the isosceles right triangle in the simplest lune “a quarter of a square”. The triangle is half a square; the incorrect phrase has been removed, while the arc remains correctly described as a quarter-circle.
localizations.ru: В описании простейшей луночки равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник ошибочно назван «четвертью квадрата». Треугольник составляет половину квадрата; ошибочное уточнение удалено, а дуга по-прежнему описана как четверть окружности.

questions.resolution: Removed the incorrect phrase “a quarter of a square”. The isosceles right triangle is half a square, while the sector centred at C is a quarter-circle.
